warning: This file specifies tests to implement. It is not an executable test runner and contains no measured results.
result_rules: Freeze configured limits and the workload profile before each recorded run.
Never replace not_run/blocked/skipped with passed without executing the corresponding oracle.
Record environment and code identity, failures and timeouts, not only successful samples.
Private hiring tasks and external non-lab systems are out of scope for these fault tests.

tests.title: Privileged preflight and ownership boundary
tests.procedure: Inspect kernel features, architecture, free space, lab marker and every candidate device before any mutation.
tests.pass_condition: Refuses an unmarked host, unsupported feature, insufficient capacity or device outside the lab allowlist; reports blocked, never a simulated pass.

tests.title: Repeatable setup and scoped cleanup
tests.procedure: Create the lab twice and clean it up; keep unrelated sentinel processes, files and network rules.
tests.pass_condition: Setup is idempotent and cleanup removes only owned resources; unrelated sentinels remain unchanged.

tests.title: All listeners and application separation
tests.procedure: Send uniquely identified payloads through every configured listener with multiple applications.
tests.pass_condition: Every successful response belongs to the expected application; no cross-app fallback; all configured ports are exercised.

tests.title: DNS and initial-connect fallback
tests.procedure: Place an unresolvable and a connection-refusing target alongside a healthy target.
tests.pass_condition: New connections succeed via a valid target within the declared total establishment budget; failed targets are observable.

tests.title: All backends unavailable
tests.procedure: Make all targets unavailable and continue opening connections.
tests.pass_condition: Every attempt fails within the configured deadline without stuck tasks, unbounded retries or leaked permits.

tests.title: TCP half-close and content integrity
tests.procedure: Send a request, close only the client write half, then read a backend response larger than the forwarding buffer.
tests.pass_condition: The full response is received and verified; EOF in one direction does not prematurely cut off the other direction.

tests.title: Per-application overload isolation
tests.procedure: Exhaust application A connection permits while continuously probing application B.
tests.pass_condition: A receives the documented overload behavior; B meets its predeclared success/latency budget; total permits remain bounded.

tests.title: Slow reader and bounded buffers
tests.procedure: Keep clients open but reading slowly while backends send data.
tests.pass_condition: Memory/queue measurements remain within the configured budgets, and unrelated application probes keep their declared budget.

tests.title: Connection churn resource recovery
tests.procedure: Run repeated connect/transfer/disconnect batches, including cancellation and backend errors.
tests.pass_condition: Open descriptors, tasks and permits return to the stated post-warmup band; no unexplained monotonic resource growth.

tests.title: Atomic configuration replacement
tests.procedure: Apply an invalid update during traffic, then a valid one.
tests.pass_condition: Invalid input does not replace the last usable view; valid change follows the documented new/existing connection policy.

tests.title: Draining and midstream failure semantics
tests.procedure: Drain a proxy with established sessions; separately kill a backend after it has received bytes.
tests.pass_condition: Drain follows its configured deadline; midstream failure is surfaced, never silently replayed to another backend.

tests.title: Measured direct-versus-proxy comparison
tests.procedure: Run the same declared workload directly and through the proxy, with repeated trials and a saturation case.
tests.pass_condition: Report includes environment, payloads, concurrency, successes, failures, timeouts, latency, throughput, CPU, memory and descriptors; no invented numeric results.

tests.title: Tunnel-only application access
tests.procedure: Probe the same HTTP service through its base-network and WireGuard addresses.
tests.pass_condition: Direct application access is blocked, tunnel access succeeds, encrypted transport is allowed, and management remains reachable.

tests.title: Seven distinct misconfiguration repairs
tests.procedure: Individually inject at least seven applicable original network faults and repair each running fixture.
tests.pass_condition: Each case has its own before/after evidence and passes N01 afterward; a known seed is labelled replay rather than blind diagnosis.

tests.title: In-place diagnosis rather than replacement
tests.procedure: Record original VM/process IDs and configuration; diagnose one composite incident without rebuilding the environment.
tests.pass_condition: Running configuration is actually repaired; evidence separates observation from hypothesis and identifies the changed controls.

tests.title: Recover existing data volume
tests.procedure: Seed object checksums, inject a reversible LVM/mount configuration error, then recover the existing volume.
tests.pass_condition: Independent client verifies all previously acknowledged immutable data covered by the durability contract; no reformat/reseed is passed off as recovery.

tests.title: Four devices and filesystem expansion
tests.procedure: Build the isolated four-by-1800-MiB fixture and enlarge the existing data LV and filesystem to at least 4 GiB.
tests.pass_condition: Reports physical backing, VG free extents, observed LV size and observed filesystem size; existing data hashes still match.

tests.title: Automatic 500-MiB growth under service load
tests.procedure: Write immutable objects until the configured usage threshold is crossed.
tests.pass_condition: Controller performs the rounded equivalent of a 500-MiB increment, enlarges the filesystem and records downtime/errors honestly; retained hashes verify.

tests.title: Expansion concurrency and restart
tests.procedure: Start concurrent controller instances and interrupt one after the LV changed but before its final state update.
tests.pass_condition: Recovery reconciles actual capacity, avoids unintended duplicate growth and preserves the configured allocation cap.

tests.title: Insufficient backing space
tests.procedure: Exhaust only the fixture allocation headroom and request another growth step.
tests.pass_condition: Stops or degrades safely with an alert; no endless retry, no claim of added physical capacity, and no consumption beyond the lab reserve.

tests.title: Data owner loss is not empty-disk failover
tests.procedure: Stop the sole owner of the object workload while another empty worker remains up.
tests.pass_condition: Requests fail explicitly rather than being treated as success on an unrelated volume; after owner recovery the client hashes still verify.

tests.title: Supported OCI image materialization
tests.procedure: Fetch a pinned owned fixture, verify layers, and apply a layer that removes a prior file.
tests.pass_condition: Filesystem content and hashes match the independent fixture manifest; deletion semantics are observed.

tests.title: Corrupt, missing and unsupported image input
tests.procedure: Serve a bad digest, missing blob and unsupported media type in separate attempts.
tests.pass_condition: Each failure is classified; no partial image becomes registered as usable; errors are bounded.

tests.title: Archive containment and resource bounds
tests.procedure: Use owned malicious fixtures containing traversal/link escapes and expansion/resource-limit cases.
tests.pass_condition: No write reaches sentinel paths outside the extraction root; limits are enforced and incomplete resources are not activated.

tests.title: Real snapshot and immutable origin
tests.procedure: Prepare a real thin device, snapshot it and modify a file only in the writable snapshot.
tests.pass_condition: Independent reads prove origin immutability and snapshot isolation; device identities and capacity are recorded.

tests.title: Idempotent and concurrent image requests
tests.procedure: Repeat one operation and submit concurrent identical-image operations.
tests.pass_condition: Stable identities lead to the documented deduplication outcome without conflicting devices, duplicate registered activation for the same operation or corruption.

tests.title: Crash after side effect before commit
tests.procedure: Terminate the worker at every phase boundary and immediately after each external side effect but before its success record.
tests.pass_condition: Restart reconciles incomplete work with physical resources; no double creation, false readiness or loss of an acknowledged durable operation.

tests.title: Thinpool data and metadata limits
tests.procedure: Approach configured data and metadata safety thresholds using capped fixtures.
tests.pass_condition: Both capacities are monitored; work stops safely before crossing defined boundaries and cleanup does not touch unrelated devices.

tests.title: Deterministic convergence
tests.procedure: Publish an independent sequence of owner records with controlled delay, duplication, loss and reordering.
tests.pass_condition: All connected healthy nodes converge to the expected final state within the declared local bound after delivery resumes.

tests.title: Control partition versus data reachability
tests.procedure: Block dissemination while preserving one tested data path; change a route elsewhere, then heal dissemination.
tests.pass_condition: Existing reachable routes follow documented stale-state policy; unknown changes are not falsely reported fresh; nodes reconcile after healing.

tests.title: Deletion and stale-node rejoin
tests.procedure: Delete a route while a node is isolated; restart/rejoin that node carrying an older view.
tests.pass_condition: The stale record does not win or resurrect the deleted route after reconciliation; state-ordering rules are visible.

tests.title: Invalid update containment
tests.procedure: Send a malformed or incompatible record for app A while app B is under traffic.
tests.pass_condition: Invalid state is rejected without replacing the last good view or breaking unrelated routing; failure is observable.

tests.title: Slow subscriber with finite queue
tests.procedure: Stop consumption, publish more updates than queue capacity, then resume.
tests.pass_condition: Memory/queue budgets hold, overflow is observable, and a resync restores correct current state; durable administrative actions are not discarded.

tests.title: Owner authority and stale restore
tests.procedure: Attempt one worker impersonating another and simulate restoration of old owner metadata.
tests.pass_condition: Unauthorized records cannot replace another owner; a stale restored incarnation cannot advertise until the recovery protocol reconciles authority.

tests.title: Truthful request identity and status
tests.procedure: Compare status/identity output against independently launched worker IDs and deployed artifacts.
tests.pass_condition: Values identify the serving instance, not a random fleet member; query failure produces unknown/stale rather than healthy.

tests.title: Telemetry and management during proxy failure
tests.procedure: Fail the public proxy while collecting management status, metrics, logs and a deployment trace.
tests.pass_condition: Management remains available, alerts arrive, and correlated evidence explains customer-visible impact without publishing secrets.

tests.title: Schema-incompatible canary refusal
tests.procedure: Start a replacement proxy whose required query is incompatible with the fixture schema.
tests.pass_condition: New process does not become ready or take traffic; previous version continues under the declared budget; rollback/recovery is documented.

tests.title: Dependency restart during prolonged drain
tests.procedure: Keep a proxy draining while restarting its state service under actual service supervision.
tests.pass_condition: Required recovery is not indefinitely blocked by unnecessary service-order dependencies; logs record restart and drain outcomes.

tests.title: Query plan and WAL maintenance under load
tests.procedure: Seed a sufficiently large table and introduce a controlled long reader or inefficient query.
tests.pass_condition: Shows actual plan/lock/WAL observations and supported remediation; failed reproduction is labelled honestly; no live-WAL deletion shortcut.

tests.title: Independent watchdog and diagnostic capture
tests.procedure: Stall the test proxy event loop under bounded conditions.
tests.pass_condition: Independent watchdog detects and mitigates within declared limits, preserving evidence; recovery does not repeatedly accept poison state.

tests.title: Design and coverage claims
tests.procedure: Audit the README and NOTES against implemented features and test evidence.
tests.pass_condition: Every positive capability claim maps to a result; limitations, tradeoffs and adapted versus literal coverage are clear.

tests.title: Incident account and audience-specific writing
tests.procedure: Use one real test failure to produce an operator timeline, customer update and internal handoff.
tests.pass_condition: The three documents agree with raw timestamps and observations; hypotheses are labelled and recovery is independently verified.

tests.title: Bounded volume-fork behavior
tests.procedure: Specify a generic fork feature and demonstrate an immutable/stopped-source fork.
tests.pass_condition: Source and fork initially match; later writes are isolated; notes distinguish block-level from live application consistency.

tests.title: Self-service RTT diagnostic and recipe
tests.procedure: Expose a user-enabled client/server round-trip diagnostic and explain one observed run.
tests.pass_condition: Reports application RTT in ms using elapsed time at one endpoint, identifies the actual serving instance and makes no ICMP/pure-network claim.

tests.title: Fresh environment reproduction
tests.procedure: Give a clean environment the pinned source and documented prerequisites, not the original developer running environment.
tests.pass_condition: Documented review path executes; blocked/skipped tests remain visible; published evidence is tied to the reviewed commit.

tests.title: Integrated capstone and change request
tests.procedure: Run the combined failure sequence, then implement a small new requirement and rerun affected checks.
tests.pass_condition: Capstone evidence is complete and honest; the change has an explained implementation diff and relevant regression results.

tests.title: Idempotent mock external invoice
tests.procedure: Simulate timeout after the fake payment service accepts a request, then retry.
tests.pass_condition: Independent fake-service ledger has the expected single external effect; invoice identity and retry state agree.

tests.title: Monthly multi-year aggregation
tests.procedure: Generate seeded multi-year invoices and aggregate by month.
tests.pass_condition: Results match an independent computation; units/currency, finalized/corrected records and query plan are explicit.

tests.title: Authoritative metering ledger
tests.procedure: Repeat, reorder and interrupt usage-event ingestion.
tests.pass_condition: Documented deduplication retains each accepted event exactly once in the local authoritative ledger; monitoring samples are not silently used as billing truth.

tests.title: Official Echo workload
tests.procedure: Implement a Maelstrom protocol adapter and run the current published Echo check.
tests.pass_condition: Actual checker accepts; command/version and artifacts preserved.

tests.title: Official Unique IDs workload
tests.procedure: Run the published unique-ID workload and its required fault profile.
tests.pass_condition: Actual checker accepts for that profile; no stronger global guarantee inferred.

tests.title: Official Broadcast sequence
tests.procedure: Run selected public Broadcast stages including network partitions and, if claimed, efficiency stages.
tests.pass_condition: Store a separate real result for every claimed stage; failed stages remain visible.

tests.title: Official Grow-only Counter workload
tests.procedure: Implement the official workload against the required store model.
tests.pass_condition: Actual checker accepts; local metrics-counter tests are not substituted.

tests.title: Official Kafka-style Log stages
tests.procedure: Run the declared official log stages.
tests.pass_condition: Actual checker results support only stages run; no local append-file equivalence claim.

tests.title: Official Transaction stages
tests.procedure: Run the declared public transaction/isolation stages.
tests.pass_condition: Checker results match claimed isolation levels; local SQL transactions are not substituted.

tests.title: Phoenix initial snapshot plus updates
tests.procedure: Add a real Phoenix/LiveView console with region/instance state and a race-free initial snapshot/update handoff.
tests.pass_condition: A new viewer gets complete current state and later updates; framework-specific code actually executes.

tests.title: Read-only LLM chat UX
tests.procedure: Implement the public chat-UX themes over sanitized status/docs, with failure handling and safe structured rendering.
tests.pass_condition: No secret or privileged execution access; sources and errors are visible; actual selected model integration is tested.

tests.title: Nomad workload and Elasticsearch/Kibana
tests.procedure: Run an isolated legacy profile of the demonstration workload with a development Nomad deployment and log inspection.
tests.pass_condition: Nomad actually executes the workload and its logs appear in Elasticsearch/Kibana; not just configuration screenshots.

tests.title: Isolated BGP route withdrawal
tests.procedure: Use an established router in isolated namespaces to advertise and withdraw a test prefix.
tests.pass_condition: Only lab routing is affected and independent probes/route tables document convergence.

tests.title: Prepared image actually boots or executes
tests.procedure: Integrate an established isolated runtime with the prepared filesystem.
tests.pass_condition: Running instance demonstrably uses the produced artifact; runtime/isolation limits and host requirements disclosed.

tests.title: Real multi-host or Fly-hosted profile
tests.procedure: Deploy a chosen profile to explicitly authorized hosts/account with appropriate secrets and budget.
tests.pass_condition: Record actual topology and physical failure boundaries; do not label local namespaces real multi-region infrastructure.
